verses.sloka: स उवाच महाप्राज्ञमभिगम्य प्लवङ्गमः ।रामं वचनमर्थज्ञो वरं सर्वधनुष्मताम् ।। ६.११७.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa uvāca mahāprājñamabhigamya plavaṅgamaḥ ।rāmaṁ vacanamarthajño varaṁ sarvadhanuṣmatām ।। 6.117.1 ।।

translations.english: Highly learned Hanuman greeted and spoke meaningfully to Rama, the foremost among the wielders of bow.
translations.hindi: दशोत्तरशततमः सगः तो तदा युध्यमानौ तु समरे रामरावणो । ददृशुः सबभूतानि बिस्मितेनान्तरात्मना

verses.sloka: यन्निमित्तो ऽयमारम्भः कर्मणां च फलोदयः ।तां देवीं शोकसन्तप्तां मैथिलीं द्रष्टुमर्हसि ।। ६.११७.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: yannimitto 'yamārambhaḥ karmaṇāṁ ca phalodayaḥ ।tāṁ devīṁ śokasantaptāṁ maithilīṁ draṣṭumarhasi ।। 6.117.2 ।।

translations.english: "You ought to see that noble lady Mythili, who was immersed in grief, for whose sake these actions were started and has borne fruit."
translations.hindi: अपने अपने रथों पर सवार दोनों एक दूसरे के ऊपर बढ़ा क्रोध प्रकट करते एक दूसरे को खदेड़ते थे

verses.sloka: सा हि शोकसमाविष्टा बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा ।मैथिली विजयं श्रुत्वा तव हर्षमुपागमत् ।। ६.११७.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sā hi śokasamāviṣṭā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā ।maithilī vijayaṁ śrutvā tava harṣamupāgamat ।। 6.117.3 ।।

translations.english: "Mythili who is overcome with grief on hearing your victory, was filled with tears in her eyes and desired to see you."

verses.sloka: पूर्वकात् प्रत्ययाच्चाहमुक्तो विश्वस्तया तया ।भर्तारं द्रष्टुमिच्छामि कृतार्थं सहलक्ष्मणम् ।। ६.११७.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: pūrvakāt pratyayāccāhamukto viśvastayā tayā ।bhartāraṁ draṣṭumicchāmi kṛtārthaṁ sahalakṣmaṇam ।। 6.117.4 ।।

translations.english: "In an earlier occasion having known me and trusting me expressed that she desires to see Rama with Lakshmana after victory and with gratitude."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तो हनुमता रामो धर्मभृतां वरः ।अगच्छत् सहसा ध्यानमीषद्बाष्पपरिप्लुतः ।। ६.११७.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamukto hanumatā rāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ varaḥ ।agacchat sahasā dhyānamīṣadbāṣpapariplutaḥ ।। 6.117.5 ।।

translations.english: When Hanuman had spoken like that, Rama, the upholder of righteousness, shed tears slightly and suddenly became thoughtful.
translations.hindi: प्त ° 6 द्र चतुर्मिश्चतुरों दीप हयान. प्रत्यपसपयत्‌ । ०स“क्री पेवेशमापक्षी 'हानॉमपसषेश् ११8१! । ४०४४० ११७२ . युद्धकाण्डे ओर पताकाएँ पताकाओं से जुट गई । तब श्रोरासचन्द्र जी ने अपने धनुष से पैने ओर चमचमाते. चार बाणों को छोड़ कर, रावण के घोड़ों को ऐसा मारा कि, घोडे पीछे हट गए। घोड़ों के पीछे हटने से रावण क्रुद्ध हुआ

verses.sloka: दीर्घमुष्णं विनिश्वस्य मेदिनीमवलोकयन् ।उवाच मेघसङ्काशं विभीषणमुपस्थितम् ।। ६.११७.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: dīrghamuṣṇaṁ viniśvasya medinīmavalokayan ।uvāca meghasaṅkāśaṁ vibhīṣaṇamupasthitam ।। 6.117.6 ।।

translations.english: Drawing a long hot breath, looking at the ground, he spoke to Vibheeshana, who was like a cloud standing there.
translations.hindi: चेरतुः संयुगमहीं सासारौ जलदो यथा । दर्शयित्वा तथा तौ तु गति बहुबिधां रणे ॥&॥ समरभूमि में बिचरते और बाणा को छोड़ते हुए दोनों के रथ, जल बरसाने आले बादलों को तरह देख पड़ते थे । दोनों रथ रणभूमि में विविध प्रकार की चालें दिखा,

verses.sloka: दिव्याङ्गरागां वैदेहीं दिव्याभरणभूषिताम् ।इह सीतां शिरस्स्नातामुपस्थापय मा चिरम् ।। ६.११७.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: divyāṅgarāgāṁ vaidehīṁ divyābharaṇabhūṣitām ।iha sītāṁ śirassnātāmupasthāpaya mā ciram ।। 6.117.7 ।।

translations.english: Bring Sita here without delay, bathed, anointed with celestial fragrance and adorned with wonderful ornaments.
translations.hindi: एक दूसरे के सामने हो फिर ऐसे खड़े हो गए कि, ( एक के रथ की ) धुरी (दूसरे के रथ की ) धुरी से, घोड़ों के मुख घोड़ो के मख से

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण त्वरमाणो विभीषणः ।प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं सीतां स्वाभिः स्त्रीभिरचोदयत् ।। ६.११७.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa tvaramāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।praviśyāntaḥpuraṁ sītāṁ svābhiḥ strībhiracodayat ।। 6.117.8 ।।

translations.english: When Rama had spoken in that manner, Vibheeeshana for his part hastened to the Gynaeceum and assigned through the women to convey to Sita.

verses.sloka: दिव्याङ्गरागा वैदेहि दिव्याभरणभूषिता ।यानमारोह भद्रं ते भर्ता त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति ।। ६.११७.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: divyāṅgarāgā vaidehi divyābharaṇabhūṣitā ।yānamāroha bhadraṁ te bhartā tvāṁ draṣṭumicchati ।। 6.117.9 ।।

translations.english: Then Vibheeshana, the prosperous Lord of the Rakshasas seeing Sita greeted her with palms joined together lifted it over his head (as a sign of respect).

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता तु वेदेही प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम् ।अस्नाता द्रष्टुमिच्छामि भर्तारं राक्षसाधिप ।। ६.११७.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktā tu vedehī pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇam ।asnātā draṣṭumicchāmi bhartāraṁ rākṣasādhipa ।। 6.117.10 ।।

translations.english: "Vaidehi! Anointed with a wonderful fragrance, decked with beautiful ornaments, auspicious and ascending the palanquin, your husband desires to see you."

verses.sloka: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः ।यदाह राजा भर्ता ते तत्तथा कर्तुमर्हसि ।। ६.११७.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṁ śrutvā pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।yadāha rājā bhartā te tattathā kartumarhasi ।। 6.117.11 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana, having spoken that way, Vaidehi said to the Lord of Rakshasas that she would like to see him without having a bath.

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मैथिली भर्तृदेवता ।भर्तृभक्तिव्रता साध्वी तथेति प्रत्यभाषत ।। ६.११७.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā maithilī bhartṛdevatā ।bhartṛbhaktivratā sādhvī tatheti pratyabhāṣata ।। 6.117.12 ।।

translations.english: Hearing Sita's words Vibheeshana replied saying," You will and ought to do what your husband Rama has said."

verses.sloka: ततः सीतां शिरस्स्नातां युवतीभिरलङ्कृताम् ।महार्हाभरणोपेतां महार्हाम्बरधारिणीम् ।। ६.११७.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sītāṁ śirassnātāṁ yuvatībhiralaṅkṛtām ।mahārhābharaṇopetāṁ mahārhāmbaradhāriṇīm ।। 6.117.13 ।।

translations.english: Noble Mythili (on hearing Vibheeshana), who looked upon her husband as God, said in reply, 'Alright'.

verses.sloka: आरोप्य शिबिकां दीप्तां परार्ध्याम्बरसंवृताम् ।रक्षोभिर्बहुभिर्गुप्तामाजहार विभीषणः ।। ६.११७.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: āropya śibikāṁ dīptāṁ parārdhyāmbarasaṁvṛtām ।rakṣobhirbahubhirguptāmājahāra vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.117.14 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Vibheeshana, making Sita to ascend the palanquin, covered with valuable clothes and guarded by numerous Rakshasas after she adorned herself in the best of ornaments and put on glowing wonderful clothes brought to Rama.
translations.hindi: बाण, वीर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने रावण के रथ पर फेके | तब तो रथ में बेठा हुआ राक्षसराज रावण भी क्रुद्ध हुआ

verses.sloka: सो ऽभिगम्य महात्मानं ज्ञात्वा ऽपि ध्यानमास्थितम् ।प्रणतश्च प्रहृष्टश्च प्राप्तं सीतां न्यवेदयत् ।। ६.११७.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: so 'bhigamya mahātmānaṁ jñātvā 'pi dhyānamāsthitam ।praṇataśca prahṛṣṭaśca prāptaṁ sītāṁ nyavedayat ।। 6.117.15 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Vibheeshana, making Sita to ascend the palanquin, covered with valuable clothes and guarded by numerous Rakshasas after she adorned herself in the best of ornaments and put on glowing wonderful clothes brought to Rama.

verses.sloka: तामागतामुपश्रुत्य रक्षोगृहचिरोषिताम् ।हर्षो दैन्यं च रोषश्च त्रयं राघवमाविशत् ।। ६.११७.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāmāgatāmupaśrutya rakṣogṛhaciroṣitām ।harṣo dainyaṁ ca roṣaśca trayaṁ rāghavamāviśat ।। 6.117.16 ।।

translations.english: Knowing that Sita reached also, great Rama was seen in a meditative mood absorbed in thought. Vibheeshana announced saying, 'Sita has been brought' and greeted with folded palms, full of joy.
translations.hindi: ओर उसने समर में गदाओं ओर मूसर्लो की वर्षा की | तब तो दोनों योद्धाओं में बड़ा भर्यानक और देखने वालों के रोंगृटे खड़े करनेवाला युद्ध हुआ

verses.sloka: ततः पार्श्वगतं दृष्ट्वा सविमर्शं विचारयन् ।विभीषणमिदं वाक्यमहृष्टं राघवो ऽब्रवीत् ।। ६.११७.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pārśvagataṁ dṛṣṭvā savimarśaṁ vicārayan ।vibhīṣaṇamidaṁ vākyamahṛṣṭaṁ rāghavo 'bravīt ।। 6.117.17 ।।

translations.english: On hearing that Sita had arrived, who stayed in Rakshasa's abode for long, Raghava had experienced joy, indignation, and anger, all the three at the same time.

verses.sloka: राक्षसाधिपते सौम्य नित्यं मद्विजये रत ।वैदेही सन्निकर्षं मे शीघ्रं समुपगच्छतु ।। ६.११७.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasādhipate saumya nityaṁ madvijaye rata ।vaidehī sannikarṣaṁ me śīghraṁ samupagacchatu ।। 6.117.18 ।।

translations.english: Raghava, analysed with in him, distressed and thinking deeply, seeing Vibheeshana close by, spoke these words.
translations.hindi: समुद्रो के खलबला उठने पर पातालबासी समस्त पन्नग ( नाग ) और सहखो दानव व्यथित हुए

verses.sloka: स तद्वचनमाज्ञाय राघवस्य विभीषणः ।तूर्णमुत्सारणे यत्नं कारयामास सर्वतः ।। ६.११७.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tadvacanamājñāya rāghavasya vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।tūrṇamutsāraṇe yatnaṁ kārayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।। 6.117.19 ।।

translations.english: "O gentle Vibheeshana, let Sita who sought my victory always be quickly brought near me."

verses.sloka: कञ्चुकोष्णीषिणस्तत्र वेत्रजर्जरपाणयः ।उत्सारयन्तः पुरुषाः समन्तात् परिचक्रमुः ।। ६.११७.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: kañcukoṣṇīṣiṇastatra vetrajarjarapāṇayaḥ ।utsārayantaḥ puruṣāḥ samantāt paricakramuḥ ।। 6.117.20 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Raghava's words, faithful Vibheeshana instantly assigned people to disperse from there.
translations.hindi: तब तो समस्त देवता, गन्धवे, सिद्ध, देबि, किन्नर और महोरग अत्यन्त चिन्तित हुए

verses.sloka: ऋक्षाणां वानराणां च राक्षसानां च सर्वशः ।वृन्दान्युत्सार्यमाणानि दूरमुत्ससृजुस्तदा ।। ६.११७.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣāṇāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca rākṣasānāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ।vṛndānyutsāryamāṇāni dūramutsasṛjustadā ।। 6.117.21 ।।

translations.english: Then those who were wearing coats and turbans, holding staffs in hand, warriors started moving and dispersed.
translations.hindi: गौ ब्राह्मणों का मङ्गल हो, सब लोग निरन्तर अपने अपने स्थानों पर स्थिर रहेँ ओर युद्ध में श्रोरामचन्द्र जी रावण को परास्त करें

verses.sloka: तेषामुत्सार्यमाणानां सर्वेषां ध्वनिरुत्थितः ।वायुनोद्वर्तमानस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः ।। ६.११७.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāmutsāryamāṇānāṁ sarveṣāṁ dhvanirutthitaḥ ।vāyunodvartamānasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ ।। 6.117.22 ।।

translations.english: The hordes of Bears, Vanaras and Rakshasas moving about all over there were driven away to a distance from the vicinity.
translations.hindi: SF PO OES... SiR दशोत्तरशततमः सगः ११५% इस प्रकार बार बार कहते हुए देवता तथा ऋषिगण श्रीराम ' और रावण का अत्यन्त भयङ्कर और रोमाञ्चकारी युद्ध देखने लगे

verses.sloka: उत्सार्यमाणांस्तान् दृष्ट्वा समन्ताज्जातसम्भ्रमान् ।दाक्षिण्यात्तदमर्षाच्च वारयामास राघवः ।। ६.११७.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: utsāryamāṇāṁstān dṛṣṭvā samantājjātasambhramān ।dākṣiṇyāttadamarṣācca vārayāmāsa rāghavaḥ ।। 6.117.23 ।।

translations.english: The great sound heard there was like the uproar of an ocean lashed by a storm.
translations.hindi: गन्धर्वा और अप्सराओं की टोलियाँ उस अनुपम युद्ध को देख, कह उठीं कि, जिस प्रकार आकाश की उपमा आकाश ही है ओर सागर की उपमा स्वयं सागर ही है

verses.sloka: संरब्धश्चाब्रवीद्रामश्चक्षुषा प्रदहन्निव ।विभीषणं महाप्राज्ञं सोपालम्भमिदं वचः ।। ६.११७.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: saṁrabdhaścābravīdrāmaścakṣuṣā pradahanniva ।vibhīṣaṇaṁ mahāprājñaṁ sopālambhamidaṁ vacaḥ ।। 6.117.24 ।।

translations.english: Seeing them excited to know and dispersing, Raghava stopped them out of kindness.
translations.hindi: उसी प्रकार श्रीराम-रावण के युद्ध की उपमा श्रीराम-रावण ही का य॒द्ध है । इस प्रकार कहते इए, वे सब (गन्धवे अप्सराएँ ), श्रीरामचन्द्र और रावण का युद्ध देख रहे थे

verses.sloka: किमर्थं मामनादृत्य क्लिश्यते ऽयं त्वया जनः ।निवर्तयैनमुद्योगं जनो ऽयं स्वजनो मम ।। ६.११७.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṁ māmanādṛtya kliśyate 'yaṁ tvayā janaḥ ।nivartayainamudyogaṁ jano 'yaṁ svajano mama ।। 6.117.25 ।।

translations.english: Exhibiting anger with his gaze at the uproar, Rama addressed the highly intelligent Vibheeshana resenting their action.

verses.sloka: न गृहाणि न वस्त्राणि न प्राकारास्तिरस्क्रियाः ।नेदृशा राजसत्कारा वृत्तमावरणं स्त्रियाः ।। ६.११७.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: na gṛhāṇi na vastrāṇi na prākārāstiraskriyāḥ ।nedṛśā rājasatkārā vṛttamāvaraṇaṁ striyāḥ ।। 6.117.26 ।।

translations.english: "Why are these people being troubled without disregard for me? Stop this excitement. They are my own people."

verses.sloka: व्यसनेषु न कृच्छ्रेषु न युद्धेषु स्वयंवरे ।न क्रुतौ न विवाहे च दर्शनं दुष्यति स्त्रियाः ।। ६.११७.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: vyasaneṣu na kṛcchreṣu na yuddheṣu svayaṁvare ।na krutau na vivāhe ca darśanaṁ duṣyati striyāḥ ।। 6.117.27 ।।

translations.english: "For women it is not the house, boundary wall or clothes or protective wall or screen of cloth or even this kind of royal treatment or surrounding, is the protection."
translations.hindi: ठीक उस कटे हुए सिर की तरह दूसरा सिर रावण के कन्धों पर निकल आया, तब फुर्तीले श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने बड़ी फुर्ती के साथ तुरन्त

verses.sloka: सैषा युद्धगता चैव कृच्छ्रे च महति स्थिता ।दर्शने ऽस्या न दोषः स्यान्मत्समीपे विशेषतः ।। ६.११७.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: saiṣā yuddhagatā caiva kṛcchre ca mahati sthitā ।darśane 'syā na doṣaḥ syānmatsamīpe viśeṣataḥ ।। 6.117.28 ।।

translations.english: "The appearance of a woman in public is not condemned in times of difficulty, in straits, in conflicts, in the selection of a husband, or in sacrificial ceremonies or marriage ceremonies."
translations.hindi: उस युद्ध में रावण के दसरे सिर को भी बाण से काट डाला जैसे ही वह दूसरा सिर कट कर नीचे गिरा, बैसे ही तीसरा नया सिर ( कठे हुए सिर की जगहू ) निकला हुआ देख पड़ा

verses.sloka: तदानय समीपं मे शीघ्रमेनां विभीषण ।सीता पश्यतु मामेषा सुहृद्गणवृतं स्थितम् ।। ६.११७.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadānaya samīpaṁ me śīghramenāṁ vibhīṣaṇa ।sītā paśyatu māmeṣā suhṛdgaṇavṛtaṁ sthitam ।। 6.117.29 ।।

translations.english: "Sita is in distress and in a highly miserable situation. Her appearance is no fault especially in my presence."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण सविमर्शो विभीषणः ।रामस्योपानयत् सीतां सन्निकर्षं विनीतवत् ।। ६.११७.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa savimarśo vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।rāmasyopānayat sītāṁ sannikarṣaṁ vinītavat ।। 6.117.30 ।।

translations.english: "Therefore, leaving the palanquin let Vaidehi walk on foot only towards me with the help of these Vanaras."
translations.hindi: बढ़ाने वाले एवं समस्त आस्न शस्त्रॉ के जानने व तो के जानने वाले

verses.sloka: ततो लक्ष्मणसुग्रीवौ हनुमांश्च प्लवङ्गमः ।निशम्य वाक्यं रामस्य बभूवुर्व्यथिता भृशम् ।। ६.११७.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato lakṣmaṇasugrīvau hanumāṁśca plavaṅgamaḥ ।niśamya vākyaṁ rāmasya babhūvurvyathitā bhṛśam ।। 6.117.31 ।।

translations.english: Rama having spoken clearly in that way, Vibheeshana reverently conducted Sita to Rama.

verses.sloka: कलत्रनिरपेक्षैश्च इङ्गितैरस्य दारुणैः ।अप्रीतमिव सीतायां तर्कयन्ति स्म राघवम् ।। ६.११७.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: kalatranirapekṣaiśca iṅgitairasya dāruṇaiḥ ।aprītamiva sītāyāṁ tarkayanti sma rāghavam ।। 6.117.32 ।।

translations.english: There upon Lakshmana, Sugriva, and Vanara Hanuman, astonished at Rama's statement, became highly distressed.
translations.hindi: क्रोंचारण्य में विराध को और दण्डक वन में कबन्ध को मारा था, वे ही मेरे सब वाण युद्ध में कई बार परीक्षा किए (आजमाये) हुए हैं अर्थात्‌ इन पर मुझे पूरा विश्‍वास है

verses.sloka: लज्जया त्ववलीयन्ती स्वेषु गात्रेषु मैथिली ।विभीषणेनानुगता भर्तारं सा ऽभ्यवर्तत ।। ६.११७.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: lajjayā tvavalīyantī sveṣu gātreṣu maithilī ।vibhīṣaṇenānugatā bhartāraṁ sā 'bhyavartata ।। 6.117.33 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Rama having no regard towards Sita, and his harsh gestures, Lakshmana and Sugriva discussed if Rama was displeased with Sita?
translations.hindi: किन्तु समझ में नहीं आता कि, रावण के लिए ये क्‍यों मोथरे हो गए हैं । इस प्रकार सोचते हुए युद्ध में सावधान

verses.sloka: सा वस्त्रसंरुद्धमुखी लज्जया जनसंसदि ।रुरोदासाद्य भर्तारमार्यपुत्रेति भाषिणी ।। ६.११७.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sā vastrasaṁruddhamukhī lajjayā janasaṁsadi ।rurodāsādya bhartāramāryaputreti bhāṣiṇī ।। 6.117.34 ।।

translations.english: Mythili, also adopting modesty, shrinking into her own limbs, approached her husband followed by Vibheeshana.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जो ने रावण की छाती पर बाणवृष्टि की। तब लो रथ पर सवार राक्षसराज रावण भी क्रुद्ध हुआ

verses.sloka: विस्मयाच्च प्रहर्षाच्च स्नेहाच्च पतिदेवता ।उदैक्षत मुखं भर्तुः सौम्यं सोम्यतरानना ।। ६.११७.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: vismayācca praharṣācca snehācca patidevatā ।udaikṣata mukhaṁ bhartuḥ saumyaṁ somyatarānanā ।। 6.117.35 ।।

translations.english: Sita, a gentle lady, who considered her husband as God only wondered with a mixed feeling of joy and affection and looked at the gentle face of Rama.
translations.hindi: चा० रा० यु०=५४ ११७८ युद्धकाण्डे ओर उसने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ऊपर युद्ध में गदा और मूसलों के प्रहार किए तब तो फिर बड़ी घमासान और रोंगटे खड़े करने वाली लड़ाई होने लगी

verses.sloka: अथ समपनुदन्मनःक्लमं सा सुचिरमदृष्टमुदीक्ष्य वै प्रियस्य ।वदनमुदितपूर्णचन्द्रकान्तं विमलशशाङ्कनिभानना तदानीम् ।। ६.११७.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: atha samapanudanmanaḥklamaṁ sā suciramadṛṣṭamudīkṣya vai priyasya ।vadanamuditapūrṇacandrakāntaṁ vimalaśaśāṅkanibhānanā tadānīm ।। 6.117.36 ।।

translations.english: Then, gazing upon the face of her beloved, unseen for so long, lovely as the risen full moon, she whose own face was like the stainless moon shed all the weariness of her heart.
translations.hindi: यह लड़ाई केवल समर भूमि ही में नहीं, किन्तु कमी आकाश सें, कभी भूमि पर ओर कभी पवतशिखर पर होतां थी। उस महायुद्ध को देखते देखते देवताओं, दानवों, यक्षों, (शाचों, उर गो अर राक्षसा को एक पूरा दिन ओर एक पूरी रात बीत गई

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे सप्तदशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। ११७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe saptadaśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 117 ।।

translations.hindi: रात या दिन में एक मुहूत्त अथवा एक चण के लिए भी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी और रावण का यह युद्ध बन्द न हुआ
